We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "Our platform engineer wants to rotate a long-lived API key and asked me to confirm whether that invalidates the old key immediately or allows an overlap."

From DOC-023: Generating a new API key does not automatically revoke the old one — both keys are valid until old is revoked. Also there is an overlap window: you can deploy new key, confirm works, then revoke old key. So answer: rotation allows overlap; old key remains valid until explicitly revoked.

Thus we can answer directly. No need to escalate. Use post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"When you rotate an API key, the old key is not revoked automatically. The new key is generated and both keys remain valid at the same time until you explicitly revoke the old one. This overlap window lets you deploy the new key, verify everything works, and only then revoke the old key to avoid any downtime."}
